scope: 500 complete warm classify calls per run; includes artifact stat/cache, inference, abstention, contributions, result construction. Excludes first artifact load, Django and network. Local development measurements, not a PythonAnywhere guarantee.
input: Cycle through the 72 frozen held-out example texts; prediction metrics and model parameters are not changed by this benchmark.
notes: Both local runs meet the warm p95 target of less than 50 ms.
Maximum latency includes observed local scheduling spikes; these are reported rather than discarded.
The training evaluation report separately records a 500-call core+abstention Linux CPU benchmark.
